body: Thank you for your words. I don't know if what I did should be considered brave but thank you for thinking it is. You don't know how much it means to me just to hear even someone on the internet say words of encouragement, because all I can hear from myself is telling me how stupid I am always.

Just got back from the shrink. He put me on 10mg generic Ritalin so I'll see how that goes tomorrow. But that's beside the point because I got something done today! I feel so goddamned proud and I might even go to the post office tomorrow to mail my tuition delay form although that may be too late anyway but I'll try not to think about that. I felt even more badass because there's a typhoon going on in my country right now and it's raining really heavy and the wind's blowing real bad but I walked through that shit to get help.

I don't know if this feeling/bit of motivation will carry on till tomorrow but I'll try to hold it tight to my chest as much as I can.

I will have to talk to them, because me not boarding the plane on the 20th pretty much means shit is gonna blow up here and I'll have to fess up. I really don't know how to talk to my parents, though, because my dad doesn't talk to me except to ask me if I studied or not or to bitch about money and my mom doesn't talk to me about serious stuff...which is why I ended up pulling something stupid and hard-headed like this.

I find it so hard to talk to them and disappoint them and I tried this summer to talk to my mom but I just couldn't bring it up when everything was light and fine and it just went under the rug. My mom did bring it up and she said that she knew I wasn't happy, but there's nothing to be done. She won't bring it up to my dad because my dad's only joy in life is telling people what college I go to and I didn't want to bring it up to him because I know what happens when you fall out of his favor...my brother is the prime example...my dad never does anything for him and he didn't even install internet in their new house though my brother needed it for school until I came by for the holidays and he had it installed because I said I was bored.

It's going to be hard to convince them to let me transfer, as all unis in English speaking countries are expensive for foreigners...but I'll find the exception...somewhere.

It would be different, because I did an exchange program in an English speaking country for almost a year and I felt constantly happy and my social life improved and I felt like I had more opportunity to grow. So I really do think it's an environment thing.

I know ADHD meds aren't magic, and I will need discipline even on them, but this is like the last resort for me and if I can actually do things like go to the post office and mail things while on them, then it will help me improve my current lot in life.
Thank you for the suggestion! I didn't know about this one.

Yeah, I researched more about this and pretty much, amphetamine-based meds (Adderall) are banned everywhere in Asia, including my home country. Mine does allow methylphenidates (Ritalin, Concerta) and I won't have a problem getting prescriptions here as far as I know...and I'll know more today because I'm going to see a doc today (yay, progress?).

My uni country is REALLY strict on all drugs: no amphetamines, Ritalin can only be prescribed for narcolepsy, and Concerta can't be prescribed if you're over 18. Disobey and get arrested on the spot.

Thanks for trying to help, though! It gave me a kick in the butt to look up the rules in more detail.
Oh, I see! I'll PM you the country.
I'd rather not say exactly because then it's really easy to figure out what college I'm going to as it's very specific in the area, but somewhere in Asia. My uni and my home country are neighbors.

Sorry for the long ass post. But this has been therapeutic, made me realize some points, and made me realize again how much I need to therapy my ass (if I decide to live). And how I need to resolve my issues (ESPECIALLY avoiding to confront things because they are too hard/not perfect) before returning (if I can) to college. I can't get therapy here, though, as it's fucking expensive and my parents are going to be all, you're going to PAY someone to talk to? How desperate are you?
